= Libraries

Libraries, frameworks, and tools, organized by category.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/animation-libraries/index.adoc[Animation libraries]* \
  JavaScript libraries for animating values, tweening, and easing over time.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/audio-video-and-image-processing/index.adoc[Audio, video, and image processing]* \
  Libraries for processing, converting, and manipulating audio, video, and image
  files.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/browser-extension-api-abstractions-and-sdks/index.adoc[Browser extension API abstractions and sdks]* \
  Libraries and starter kits for building browser extensions across Chrome,
  Firefox, and other browsers.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/canvas-and-svg-abstractions/index.adoc[Canvas and SVG abstractions]* \
  Libraries that simplify working with the Canvas and SVG APIs for drawing and
  graphics.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/css-libraries/index.adoc[CSS libraries]* \
  CSS frameworks and libraries.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/css-themes/index.adoc[CSS themes]* \
  Pre-built CSS themes and design systems for styling projects.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/css-utility-class-libraries/index.adoc[CSS utility class libraries]* \
  Utility-class and atomic CSS frameworks, plus a few full component and design
  systems.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/tailwind-css/index.adoc[Tailwind CSS]* \
  Tailwind CSS, the utility-first CSS framework.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/tailwind-tools/index.adoc[Tailwind tools]* \
  Tools that complement Tailwind CSS, such as fluid typography and color scale
  generators.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/css-in-js-libraries/index.adoc[CSS-in-JS libraries]* \
  Libraries for writing CSS directly in JavaScript or JSX, usually with
  zero-runtime or near-zero-runtime output.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/css-resets-and-baseline-stylesheets/index.adoc[CSS resets and baseline stylesheets]* \
  CSS resets and baseline stylesheets for normalizing browser default styles.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/css-color-manipulation/index.adoc[CSS color manipulation]* \
  Libraries for parsing, converting, and manipulating CSS colors in JavaScript.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/other-css-libraries-and-tools/index.adoc[Other CSS libraries and tools]* \
  CSS libraries and tools that don't fit into the other categories.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/data-fetching/index.adoc[Data fetching]* \
  Libraries for fetching, caching, and synchronizing remote data in JavaScript
  applications.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/graphql/index.adoc[GraphQL]* \
  Tools and clients for working with GraphQL APIs.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/dom-abstractions/index.adoc[DOM abstractions]* \
  Libraries that abstract or simplify direct DOM manipulation, including virtual
  DOM implementations.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/data-storage-local/index.adoc[Data storage (local)]* \
  Libraries for storing and querying data locally in the browser.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/data-visualization/index.adoc[Data visualization]* \
  Libraries and tools for visualizing data, including several built on D3.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/diagram-generation/index.adoc[Diagram generation]* \
  Tools for generating diagrams programmatically, including diagrams-as-code
  approaches.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/favicon-manipulation/index.adoc[Favicon manipulation]* \
  Libraries for dynamically updating the favicon, e.g. to show badges or
  notifications.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/form-validation/index.adoc[Form validation]* \
  Libraries for validating HTML form input on the client side.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/input-masks-and-validation/index.adoc[Input masks and validation]* \
  Libraries for masking and validating text input in form fields.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/micro-frontend-solutions/index.adoc[Micro-frontend solutions]* \
  Frameworks and tools for composing micro-frontends from independently deployed
  applications.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/popup-element-management/index.adoc[Popup element management]* \
  Libraries for positioning tooltips, popovers, and other floating UI elements.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/routing/index.adoc[Routing]* \
  Client-side routing libraries for single-page applications.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/server-sent-events-sse/index.adoc[Server sent events (SSE)]* \
  Libraries for working with Server-Sent Events (SSE) in JavaScript.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/state-management/index.adoc[State management]* \
  Libraries for managing application state, including the Redux, Vuex, and Pinia
  ecosystems.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/template-engines/index.adoc[Template engines]* \
  Client-side and server-side templating engines for generating HTML.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/web-component-abstractions-and-compilers/index.adoc[Web component abstractions and compilers]* \
  Libraries and compilers for building native web components with less
  boilerplate.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/web-component-wrappers/index.adoc[Web component wrappers]* \
  Libraries for wrapping web components so they integrate cleanly with frameworks
  like Vue and React.

* *xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/libraries/polyfills/index.adoc[Polyfills]* \
  Polyfills and shims for adding missing or newer JavaScript and browser features
  to older environments.
